<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/analytics/assets/by-audit-policy-schedule-status/{AssetAuditPolicyScheduleId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns asset counts grouped by audit policy status (Verified, Pending, At Risk, Failed) for a single audit policy schedule. This endpoint narrows the analytics query to assets currently assigned to the schedule so you can track compliance for a specific audit run cadence.

**Prerequisites**
1. **AssetAuditPolicyScheduleId** – Use [POST /api/v1.0/assets](/docs/api/assets/search-assets) to locate an asset governed by the target schedule, then load [GET /api/v1.0/assets/\{assetId\}](/docs/api/assets/get-asset-by-id) and read `Item.AssetAuditPolicyScheduleId` from the response.

**Workflow Example**
1. Search assets: [POST /api/v1.0/assets](/docs/api/assets/search-assets) and select an asset assigned to the desired audit schedule.
2. Load the asset: [GET /api/v1.0/assets/\{assetId\}](/docs/api/assets/get-asset-by-id) to capture `Item.AssetAuditPolicyScheduleId`.
3. Call [GET /api/v1.0/analytics/assets/by-audit-policy-schedule-status/\{AssetAuditPolicyScheduleId\}](/docs/api/analytics/get-asset-counts-by-audit-policy-schedule-status) to retrieve the compliance distribution.
4. Use the counts to populate schedule-level compliance reporting or escalation alerts.

**Minimal Required Fields**: `AssetAuditPolicyScheduleId` (path).
